Best medical dermatology in Rajkot.

Advanced Skin Clinic Rajkot offers comprehensive medical dermatology services and treatments. Find out more about the most common skin conditions we treat.

Acne Treatment

Acne is a condition of skin where hair follicles become blocked with oil and dead skin cells — usually due to hormones.

Learn More →

Psoriasis

Psoriasis is a skin disorder that causes skin cells to multiply up to 10 times faster than normal, building up into bumpy red patches.

Tinea

Tinea is the name of a group of diseases caused by a fungus. Types include ringworm, athlete's foot and jock itch.

Eczema

Eczema is a term for a group of medical conditions that cause the skin to become inflamed or irritated. The most common type is atopic dermatitis.

Urticaria

Also known as hives — an outbreak of swollen, pale red bumps or plaques (wheals) on the skin that appear suddenly.

Vitiligo

Vitiligo (leukoderma / safed daag) is a common skin condition in India characterized by white patches on the skin.

Wart

Warts are small, round, elevated non-cancerous skin growths that affect the topmost layer of the skin, caused by a virus.

Scabies

A contagious, intensely itchy skin condition caused by a tiny burrowing mite — spreads quickly within a family.

Pemphigus

A rare skin disorder characterized by blistering of the skin. There are two main types: Vulgaris and Foliaceus.
